default.question: What payment methods do you support?
default.answer: We support all major payment methods, including credit and debit cards, digital wallets, and bank transfers both locally and globally worldwide.

default.question: Can I accept payments in multiple currencies?
default.answer: Yes! Our platform allows you to accept payments in multiple currencies and automatically handles foreign exchange (FX) for a global experience.

default.question: Do you support subscription or recurring billing?
default.answer: Yes! Our platform can handle any billing model, including subscriptions, usage-based billing, and one-time payments, giving you full flexibility.

default.question: Is my payment data secure?
default.answer: Absolutely. We use advanced encryption and comply with PCI-DSS standards to ensure your customers’ payment data is safe and secure.

default.question: Can I track cash flow in real time?
default.answer: Yes. Our dashboard gives you real-time insights into incoming and outgoing payments, helping you make smarter financial decisions instantly.
